The '''Derellium system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].<ref name="Xim Week" /> It was situated within the historical [[Greater Tion]] region,<ref name="Xim Week" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derellium]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

The Derellium system sat at the intersection of three [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], the [[Greater Cronese Arc]], the [[Lesser Cronese Arc]] and the [[Indrexu Route]], which connected it to the [[Duinarbulon system/Legends|Duinarbulon]], [[Eibon system/Legends|Eibon]] and [[Panna system/Legends|Panna systems]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Derellium_system_TEA.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The Derellium system was part of [[Xim's empire]]]]
The Derellium system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. It was erroneously mentioned as the Derilium system in the book's map of the conquests of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]].
